context_for_next_testing_agent: The SD-3 sorted-order bug from iteration_100 is fully resolved. If future changes touch /app/backend/routes/sd3.py::create_pair, re-run test_iteration_112.py 5x to guard against regression. FYI: dashboard shows 500s on /api/statements and /api/budget/current for cathy@example.com — orthogonal to this fix.
rca of the issue: Original RCA (iteration_100): create_pair fetched a,b in payload order but stored the pair with sorted statement_a_id/statement_b_id — so candidate.statement_a_line_id could reference a line in the pair's stored statement_b, causing draft_letter to return {} for _line_by_id. Fix: after computing ids_sorted, swap a,b (a,b = b,a) when ids_sorted[0] != payload.statement_a_id, ensuring candidate line_ids align with the pair's stored (sorted) order. Verified via 5 consecutive full runs of test_iteration_112.py and full 60-test suite.
